definitions.gloss: leader; guide; one who leads the way
definitions.explanation: A person who goes ahead and leads others, either literally (guiding a group) or figuratively (pioneering a field or movement).

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はこの{分野|ぶんや}の{先導者|せんどうしゃ}だ。
examples.english: He is a pioneer in this field.

examples.japanese: {先導者|せんどうしゃ}の{指示|しじ}に{従|したが}って{行進|こうしん}してください。
examples.english: Please march following the guide's instructions.

examples.japanese: {技術|ぎじゅつ}{革新|かくしん}の{先導者|せんどうしゃ}として、その{企業|きぎょう}は{世界|せかい}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}えた。
examples.english: As a trailblazer in technological innovation, that company influenced the world.

notes:
Compound of {先導|せんどう} (guidance; leading the way) + {者|しゃ} (person). Used for both literal guides (parade leaders, tour guides) and figurative pioneers (industry leaders, thought leaders).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先導者|せんどうしゃ}として{活躍|かつやく}する: to be active as a leader
- {先導者|せんどうしゃ}の{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす: to fulfill the role of a guide
- {業界|ぎょうかい}の{先導者|せんどうしゃ}: industry leader

SIMILAR WORDS:
- リーダー: leader — more casual, widely used in everyday contexts
- {指導者|しどうしゃ}: leader; instructor — emphasizes teaching and directing, often for political or organizational leaders
- {先駆者|せんくしゃ}: pioneer; forerunner — emphasizes being the first to do something, stronger sense of breaking new ground
- {案内人|あんないにん}: guide — specifically a person who shows the way, more practical than figurative
